__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand in the archway of a gigantic stone archway. The two
steel gates have been forced open and have rusted in place. A hollow
gust of wind blows by you into the deserted, and seemingly destroyed,
city.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a trail out of this blasted place.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5200 to 5256

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
You see devastation everywhere. Houses lie in ruin and skeletons litter
the streets. You see strange beasts stalking the shadows.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5200 to 5201

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Grand Gate of Thalos

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This was once a magnificent street, but now is in total ruin. The
streets are barren and windswept and the silence is unending.  A dark alley
leads north and south.  Howls and screams echo through the deserted city.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: It's a dark alley.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5201 to 5239

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The entrance to the city lies this way.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5201 to 5200

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: It's a dark alley.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5201 to 5255

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Main Street lies this way.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5201 to 5202

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Main Street

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This was once a magnificent street, but now is in total ruin. The
streets are barren and windswept and the silence is unending. On one
side is a collapsed house while on the other is the entrance to a large
ruined mansion. Eerie sounds echo within the mansion. Near the center of
town you see a large domed building, relatively intact.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The remnants of a store lie this way.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5202 to 5236

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: It looks like what used to be the main building in the city.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5202 to 5232

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A withered garden path lies this way.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5202 to 5203

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Main Street

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
A circular path surrounds a magnificent domed temple in the center of
the city. Flowers have withered away and the once lush trees are bare.
Vines and ivy snake up the sides of the temple and entangle themselves
around your feet. A sudden volley of howls pierces the air.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The garden path continues around the building.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5203 to 5204

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: This is the main street leading to the city's entrance
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5203 to 5202

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The garden path continues around the building.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5203 to 5206

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
Inside the temple, small patches of light shoot through each doorway as
well as a few holes in the ceiling.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5203 to 5250

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Garden Path

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
A circular path surrounds a magnificent domed temple in the center of
the city. Flowers have withered away and the once lush trees are bare.
Vines and ivy snake up the sides of the temple and entangle themselves
around your feet. A sudden volley of howls pierces the air.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A side street leads off to the northern half of the city.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5204 to 5211

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The garden path continues around the building.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5204 to 5203

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The garden path continues around the building.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5204 to 5205

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Garden Path

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
A circular path surrounds a magnificent domed temple in the center of
the city. Flowers have withered away and the once lush trees are bare.
Vines and ivy snake up the sides of the temple and entangle themselves
around your feet. A sudden volley of howls pierces the air.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The garden path continues around the building.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5205 to 5204

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
Inside the temple, small patches of light shoot through each doorway as
well as a few holes in the ceiling.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5205 to 5250

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Garden Path

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
A circular path surrounds a magnificent domed temple in the center of
the city. Flowers have withered away and the once lush trees are bare.
Vines and ivy snake up the sides of the temple and entangle themselves
around your feet. A sudden volley of howls pierces the air.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The garden path continues around the building.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5206 to 5203

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A small side street leads to the southern half of the city.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5206 to 5212

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Garden Path

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand in the middle of a large square lined on each side with
baskets, carts, and stands of all shapes and sizes. Abandoned, these
little shops still contain some of their goods once sold to a demanding
public.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
A small table has been toppled over, spilling fine jewelery and gems
onto the ground.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5207 to 5225

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Rotted remains of fruits and vegetables lie strewn about.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5207 to 5220

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The market place continues.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5207 to 5208

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The market place

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand at the end of the market square. Stands and carts line
each side, filled with remnants of fine foods and exquisite goods.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Tattered carpets and ruined bales of silk sit idly by a run down stand.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5208 to 5222

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The center of the market lies this way.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5208 to 5207

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
From the massive stench, this must have been a meat and poultry stand.
It lies totally bare.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5208 to 5217

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The market place

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This small side street leads east and west into back alleys while
to the south you see the temple. The incessant howling tears at your mind.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Side Street

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in the common section of the city. Ruined buildings made of
clay and stone is all the view has to offer. Most of these homes are
nothing but piles of rubble, but some look almost safe enough to venture
into. The street continues north and south and buildings line the street.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A small doorway leads into a partially collapsed house.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5210 to 5244

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A small clay dwelling sits here.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5210 to 5226

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Side Street

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This small side street leads away from the garden path to the south.
Around you stand large piles or rubble where the houses of commoners
used to be. A lone howl makes you worry greatly about your safety here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: An unusually tall dwelling stands looming over you.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5211 to 5237

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A garden path circles around the temple.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5211 to 5204

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Here lies a small stone house with a thatched roof.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5211 to 5227

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Side Street

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This small side street leads south away from the temple into the
business section of town. The destruction that leveled this city was not
biased; these important looking buildings have been almost totally
destroyed. There is a hole in the wall of a very large structure to the
east.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A small garden path encircles the temple.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5212 to 5206

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: This possibly could be the city hall.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5212 to 5232

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
Inside the building you see long pieces of metal, an oven, and some
anvils.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5212 to 5221

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A side street

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This small side street is lined with the remains of once great
buildings. To the north is a dark, foreboding structure while to the
east lies the entrance to a small tavern. The street continues north
and south.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
From the looks of it, this was once a two story abode. The entire second
floor has collapsed leaving a very little part of the bar still free
from debris.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5213 to 5230

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
This seems to be the only guild house in the entire city. Its dark nature
makes you wonder about its origins.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5213 to 5219

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A side street

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are at the end of a long street leading to the center of the city.
A long dark alley runs east and west.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A side street

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand at the base of a tall watchtower built to protect the city
from invaders. From the looks of things, it did not do a good job.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Under a ruined watchtower

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This alley leads to the rear of what used to be a meat stand. You wince
at the stench. South is one of the city watchtowers.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see the back-side of the market place meat stand.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5216 to 5217

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A tall watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5216 to 5215

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A back alley

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
A large stand has been set up here with metal hooks and wooden racks
in the background. Hanging on the hooks are very small scraps of meat
and other game. This stand is relatively empty, and a sudden burst of
howling and screaming makes you realize why this is so.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The market place lies this way.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5217 to 5208

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: This is a cart full of rotted vegetables and fruits.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5217 to 5220

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The meat stand

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
A narrow alley leads east to a wider street and west to one of
the city watchtowers.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A small side street greets you.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5218 to 5214

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A tall watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5218 to 5215

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A back alley

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are standing in what once was this city's ONLY guild house.
Tables and chairs have been smashed and broken weapons lie strewn about
the floor as if some massive battle had taken place here. Draped along
the back wall is a tattered, jet-black banner with the symbol of the
Darkside set upon it.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A small side street runs past the building.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5219 to 5213

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The guild house

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
A large cart sits here carrying rotted fruit and vegetables. Flys
swarm all about what seems to be the last remaining bits of food left
in the city.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The market place is deserted.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5220 to 5207

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A strong stench emanates from the meat stand next to you.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5220 to 5217

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The produce stand

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
In here you find tools and anvils used to make various weapons
and items. The walls have been stripped clean and only a few incomplete
pieces of armor and weaponry are left.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A small side street runs past the building.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5221 to 5212

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The smithy

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Tattered and torn tapestries and rugs lie heaped in piles. Fancy
robes and various articles of clothing are now just rags. You stare at
the strange piles for a long time until a piercing howl makes you
think these might be beds.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A fine jewelry stand lies in ruin next to you.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5222 to 5225

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The market place is deserted.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5222 to 5208

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The tapestry stand

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
A narrow alley leads north to one of the city watchtowers while
to the south there lies a market stand full of torn clothes and rugs.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A tall watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5223 to 5224

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A back alley

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand under one of the city watchtowers built to protect
the city from invaders. Obviously, it failed.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Above you looms a tall watchtower.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5224 to 5246

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Under the watchtower

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
A table has been tipped over, spilling fine jewelery and gems
across the market place. Most of these trinkets are battered and
tarnished and few would have any value anymore.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The market place is deserted.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5225 to 5207

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Next to you is a stand full of ruined clothes and rugs.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5225 to 5222

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The jewelery stand

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This was once a very plain house with nothing more than a few chairs
and a bed. A cold fireplace suggests that the city has been abandoned
for quite a while. Almost nothing remains of this humble abode.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Outside is a small side street.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5226 to 5210

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A ruined clay dwelling

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This small house has completely collapsed upon itself leaving piles
of debris here and there. A few rafters still stand with thatched straw
hanging down and a hot wind gusts through the hollow dwelling.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A small side street runs past the house.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5227 to 5211

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A collapsed stone dwelling

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
A narrow alley leads east to one of the city watchtowers and west to
a small side street.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A back alley

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
From the outside this place looks like an ordinary pile of rubble,
but inside these cramped quarters you discover what used to be a shop
filled with armor, weapons, and various other goods. A small sign flutters
in the wind.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A small side street runs past the shop.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5229 to 5214

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: An abandoned shop

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
A glorious place in it's prime, this tavern now lies in ruin; tables
and chairs are broken scattered, bottles and glasses shattered, and
a small performance stage crushed. Musical instruments and personal
belongings lie under the rubble, but the people they once belonged to are
not with them. Looking up you see that the entire second floor and roof
has fallen in, leaving a gaping hole above.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A small side street runs past the tavern.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5230 to 5213

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Tavern of the Sun

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand in a large room attached to this end of the hallway which
leads back north to the reception area.  Pedestals and columns have fallen
and most of the valuable items have been taken, leaving worthless debris.
A few chairs have survived, as well as a large curved desk. To the east
is a vine-covered archway leading out into a private courtyard.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The long hallway leads back to the main reception area of the city hall.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5231 to 5232

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: South wing of the city hall

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This is the main reception area of Thalos' city hall. The walls have
been charred and scored massively and debris is spread from wall to wall.
A large gaping hole in the west wall allows you to see out to one of
the city's side streets. Obviously no one will be seeing you through today.
Hallways lead south and east.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Main street runs past the city hall.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5232 to 5202

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A hallway leads to the east wing of the city hall.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5232 to 5233

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A hallway leads to the south wing of the city hall.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5232 to 5231

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The city hall

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Here lies the remnants of a fancy office, possibly the mayor's. A few
withered plants and broken pieces of furniture make this place anything
but fancy, though. The only thing remaining intact here is a large
glass cabinet. A long hallway leads west back to the reception area and
an ivy-covered archway leads south into a private courtyard.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: East wing of the city hall

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
What a shame that this mass destruction also touched this once
beautiful place. The temple's garden path has nothing on this garden.
Flowers and trees have been smashed into the ground and lawn benches
thrown through walls. A large marble fountain in the center of the
courtyard still stands, though, defying any attempts to destroy its
beauty. Above stands the remnants of one of the watchtowers. Archways
north and west lead back into the city hall.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The private gardens and courtyard of Thalos

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This was once the barracks for Thalos' cityguards. Now just an empty
shell, this small shack still stands guarding the entrance both to the
city and to the city hall.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The alley runs by this building.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5235 to 5255

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A small guard house

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
All that's left of this house is a few scattered piles of rubble
and a very large blast crater. Obviously someone or something important
was once housed here. A shrieking howl chills your blood.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Main street runs past this ruined home.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5236 to 5202

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A collapsed home

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This seems to be the tallest structure remaining in the city. At
one time this could have been an inn of some sort, but now it's just
a mess. The back wall as been completely knocked down revealing an
entrance into another building through yet another collapsed wall.
Between the two buildings are a few blast craters and boulders. An old
set of wooden steps leads up to a creaking second floor.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A small side street winds past the dwelling.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5237 to 5211

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
The stairs and even the entire second floor itself looks very unsafe
for travel. Gusts of wind make them creak and shudder.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5237 to 5245

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A tall dwelling

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This cramped dwelling could not have housed more than one person. Now
with the back wall missing, it could hold many more. Looking around you
find broken shelves and workbenches with various vials and pouches spilling
contents all across the floor. This was possibly the magic shop of the
city. The doorway to the east is blocked, making the only exit back west.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A small shack

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
A narrow back alley goes south to main street and north towards
a watchtower. A mass of howls catches you off guard.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Main street runs past here.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5239 to 5201

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A back alley

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
A narrow back alley leads north to one of the city watchtowers
and south towards main street. To the west is a doorway to a small
house blocked by debris.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A tall watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5240 to 5241

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A back alley

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand under a tall watchtower. Narrow back alleys lead west and
south and a very weak looking ladder leads up into the tower.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Winds howl high above your head in the tower above.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5241 to 5248

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Under a watchtower

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This was once the bath house for the commoners of the city. Hot
steamy water still wells up from a hole in the floor. Obviously there
is a hot spring located under the city (making the decision to put
a city here seem much more reasonable). Closer inspection of the water
yields a dead body floating around in it, skin melted away from months
of floating in there. The west wall has collapsed revealing another
collapsed house.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
The wall has collapsed on the adjoining house, creating a new opening
in it.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5242 to 5244

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A bath house

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
A narrow back alley leads west to a small side street and east to one
of the city watchtowers. Great amounts of steam issue forth from the
building to the south.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5243 to 5241

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A side street runs by here.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5243 to 5209

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A back alley

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This home is practically the only one around that is still standing.
Except for the massive hole in the east wall, everything else looks
intact, including the windows. Great amounts of steam issue forth from
the hole in the east wall.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A small side street runs past the house.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  5244 to 5210

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: An upright house

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The minute you step off onto this floor you realize it was a mistake.
The old rotted floorboards suddenly give way and you fall down, impaling
yourself on jagged boards below.

You've fallen, and you can't get up!!!
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: On the second floor

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand atop one of the city watchtowers. The view is magnificent

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The north-east watchtower

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand within one of the most holy places in the realm. This
stunning domed temple once housed the city's worshipers en masse.
Unfortunately, it succumbed to the destruction brought on this city.
Long benches lie toppled and the altar desecrated. Large chunks of stone
have fallen from the walls and roof, sending sunlight streaming in on
you. A few books lie about, conveying to you a holy message in a
strange tongue.
     Wind gusts through the four archways and howls and screams can be
heard from all parts of the city.
